SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CD_PLANT AS PLANT, LEGACY_PO_DATE, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','S')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'ILHW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, CD_PLANT AS PLANT, STATUS AS STATUS, LEGACY_PO_DATE||LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, CURRENCY_CODE AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE," NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(LEGACY_PO_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, PURCHASER_USER_ID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, LEGACY_PR_NO AS LEGACY_PR_NO, REQ_USER_NAME AS REQ_USER_NAME, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, REQ_USER_TEL AS REQ_USER_TEL, REMARK AS REMARK, PRE_GR_FLAG AS DOC_TYPE, PRE_GR_REMARK AS REMARK2 FROM KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','S') AND CD_PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_DATE = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_DATE$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_DATE, LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','S') AND CD_PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_DATE = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_DATE$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
